notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

So today I pushed a small update that contains the 2nd part of the Halloween Update that I was unable to finish before Next Fest and some quality-of-life changes.

I added a new spooky ghost trap. This trap is available for placement on all maps, and the Halloween map "Haunt" has had an update to its starting trap sets so that they include the ghost.

Other than that, I've made "Starting Traps" default to "Yes". This is good for new players and small groups so they can get into the action faster. Then I added control tooltip while placing traps. Also, more updates are on the way.

If you have any feedback I'd love to hear from you. It's been fun to see people enjoying the game, 
it means a lot to me. Thank you so much! <3

- Chris
